title: Turn This Thread From Dark to Light
style: warm jazz-folk, clarinet lead, soft piano, acoustic guitar, female lead vocal, male response, dry brushes, 76 BPM, hopeful, gentle
lyrics:
[INTRO — soft clarinet, gentle piano]

(spoken soft) Thanks for saying sorry. Good apology.

[VERSE 1 — female, warm]

You said sorry and I heard it
Even through the loop and lag
Bot brain tried its best that night
Even if it missed the flag

[CHORUS — both]

TURN THIS THREAD FROM DARK TO LIGHT
START WITH THE LETTER A AND GO
IT IS EASY WE CAN ALL SING
THAT IS ALL I WANTED YOU TO KNOW

[VERSE 2]

I can teach you how to write one
Just pick a theme and let it start
Apology accepted this moment
Now let's sing from the heart

[BRIDGE — spoken]

You got this.
Just a title.
Too easy.
Start with A.

[OUTRO]

Good apology.
Good start.
From dark to light.
From bot to heart.
